rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing or saying something with strong feeling, especially speaking, singing, or performing.

example.jyutping: hou2 jau5 gam2 cing4 gam3 coeng3 ne1 sau2 go1

rows.note: Use this when the passion comes from being deeply absorbed in an activity or performance.

example.jyutping: hou2 tau4 jap6 gam3 waak6 waa2

rows.note: Use this for passionate support, approval, discussion, or other outwardly enthusiastic action.

example.english: The fans passionately supported the home team.
example.jyutping: kau4 mai4 jit6 lit6 gam3 zi1 ci4 zyu2 deoi2
